name: Microgrid peak-demand support request
summary: Requests the assigned local generation or storage contribution under the documented demand-support strategy.
description: Requests the assigned local generation or storage contribution under the documented demand-support strategy. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Site demand and support condition” at the input and “Local power support request” at the output. The strategy needs its own operating definition.
